case_name: K M Gagana @ Gagana vs K M Shivanadayya @ Shivanandswami

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: SMT. K .M. GAGANA, W/O K.M. SHIVANANDAYYA, HOUSEWIFE
parties.respondent_defendant: SRI K. M. SHIVANANDAYYA, S/O K.M. VEERESHAIAH, EMPLOYEE

facts_of_case: Petitioner is the wife seeking to withdraw M.C.No.15/2022 pending on the file of the Principal Senior Civil Judge and CJM Court, Bellari sitting at II ASCJ, Siruguppa and transfer the same to the Principal Judge, Family Court, Raichur.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to rely on a document to prove its authenticity.
legal_principles.held: Though the respondent-husband tried to contend before this court that he is not physically fit who appear before the Court at Raichur due to his mental incapacity by placing reliance on Annexure - A, the same having not found in M.C.No.15/2022, where the petition was filed in the year 2022 itself and disorder certificate is as early as in the year 2019, the material placed before the Court cannot be accepted readily.
cited_cases: K M Gagana @ Gagana vs K M Shivanadayya @ Shivanandswami on 8 September, 2023

legal_principles.principle: A party's mental disorder or physical incapacitation is not a sufficient ground to dismiss a petition.
legal_principles.held: Though the respondent-husband tried to contend before this court that he is suffering from mental disorder i.e., 'Chronic Anxiety Disorder' and in order to substantiate his contention, he has placed reliance on certain documents, which are at Annexure-A. The documents produced at Annexure - A pertains to various dates inevitably prior to filing M.C.No.15/2022, the physical fitness certificate also indicates that the respondent-husband is suffering from 'Chronic Anxiety Disorder', this contention nowhere finds place in MC No.15/2022 nor the respondent-husband is represented by any next friend in MC.No.15/2022 in order to substantiate his contention that he is suffering from 'Chronic Anxiety Disorder'.
cited_cases: K M Gagana @ Gagana vs K M Shivanadayya @ Shivanandswami on 8 September, 2023

outcome.final_order: The matter was listed today (08.09.2023) but learned counsel for the respondent has remained absent.
